prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1146; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. You already have it in the file.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was at a signalized intersection in Katy, Texas. I was turning left, heading toward the shopping center on the far side.
Q: What was the signal showing when you began your turn?
A: I had a green arrow for the left turn. Or at least I thought I did. The oncoming traffic had a green light too, so I went.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I glanced up when I was already partway through the turn, and then there was a loud bang and my car spun a little.
Q: How fast were you going?
A: Slow, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. It's a turn, you don't go fast.
Q: Did you or anyone else get hurt?
A: My neck and upper back hurt right away. I didn't think much of it until the next morning. Now I have stiffness and headaches, and turning my head to check my blind spot is painful.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening and then started physical therapy. I'm still going a couple of times a week.
Q: Is there anything else you think we should know?
A: Just that I was trying to be careful. I'd like this resolved so I can get back to work without the pain.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
